user.title: Connect to MiTY
user.description: Enter your MiTY endpoint and the enrollment code for the study you're joining. Already contributing to another MiTY study? Run this setup again with that study's own code to join it too. Read the MiTY Terms & Conditions at {terms_url} before agreeing.

data.study_nickname: Name for this study (optional, helps tell multiple studies apart)
data.agree_terms: I agree to the MiTY Terms & Conditions

parameters.title: Select information to contribute
parameters.description: Choose which of your Home Assistant sensors to share with MiTY. Your device ID is {instance_id}. You can change this later from the integration's options. Leave a field blank to not share that type of data.

zones.title: Where are these sensors?
zones.description: MiTY's HERD-IoT data format requires a room/zone for every observation. Choose the zone for each sensor you mapped in the previous step.

data.zone_entity_energy_usage: Zone for the energy usage sensor

device_provenance.title: Sensor details (optional)
device_provenance.description: Optional details about your sensor hardware. MiTY uses this to document measurement provenance for research purposes -- leave blank if you don't know or don't want to share it. Applies to all sensors mapped in this setup.

data.device_measurement_uncertainty: Measurement uncertainty (±, same units as the sensor)

frequency.title: Data transmission frequency
frequency.description: How often should Home Assistant send your data to MiTY?

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to MiTY
reauth_confirm.description: "{nickname}" was rejected by MiTY on its last submission -- this usually means the device's key was revoked or reset on the MiTY side. Home Assistant will try to reconnect using this device's stored rejoin credential. Your parameter mapping and frequency won't change.

reauth_new_code.title: New enrollment code needed
reauth_new_code.description: "{nickname}" can no longer rejoin automatically -- this trial requires a fresh enrollment after leaving. Enter a current enrollment code for this study to reconnect "{nickname}" under a new device identity. Your parameter mapping and frequency won't change.

error.invalid_enroll_code: That enrollment code is invalid or no longer active. Check the code and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the MiTY endpoint. Check the URL and your network connection.
error.must_agree_terms: You must agree to the MiTY Terms & Conditions to continue.

abort.already_configured: This MiTY device is already configured.
